about: The pick rule of docs/display-rules.md R7, as one table both implementations run: the webview's (src/test/pickCases.test.ts: stagePanes.stageHover over fullLineNear, stagePanes.stageStep) and the backend's (python-backend/test_pick_cases.py: full_read.pointer_picks over _nearest_on_screen and _nearest_along, full_read._seek_line). Each case: `points` [x, value] (value null, "nan", "inf" or "-inf": no value), `plain` (no silent floor: a signal, a metric; false: a level, whose -250 and below is silence), `view` (x range and scale, value range, the plot's box in px), `pointer` (px from the box's top left) or `from` (the index read), `mode`, `expect` (the index read, or null). Mode `click` is what a click at the pointer acts on (R7, R13): the very point the readout reads there (`nearest` within the radius, else `under`), null where it reads none (and `empty` where it says "no value at this place"); the webview runs it through the readout (plotHoverLayer.clicked), never a hit test of the click's own. `not_on` names a side that cannot express the case and the reason, a key of `cannot`; `today` records what the code does where it does not yet follow the rule, with the work that changes it. `empty` (with `expect` null): the place under the pointer is in a gap of the line with no point with a value in the pick window, so the webview answers "no value at this place" (stagePanes.stageHover's `empty` read, written in words), never a blank readout, which is a read still pending; the backend answers no point there (no `under`), as for any null.

cannot.radius: the 20 px pick radius is the webview's alone (fullLineNear, plotHover.nearestPoint): the backend sends the point nearest the pointer on screen at any distance (full_read._nearest_on_screen) and the webview reads it only within the radius
cannot.no-from: the backend's seek has no `from` (StageRead): it steps by x alone, which never repeats on a line the backend holds (a spectrum, a signal, a level over time). A line whose points share an x (the distribution's recordings of one value) is held whole by the webview (localLine) and stepped by place there (R7)
cannot.no-view: the backend's seek knows no view: it answers the next point of the data, and the webview stops at the plot's side (stagePanes.stageStep)
cannot.no-click: the backend reads no click: a click acts in the webview on the point its readout reads (plotHoverLayer.clicked through clickOnRead), which is the webview's nearest within the radius, else the point under the pointer

cases.name: nearest: of the points within the radius, the one nearest the pointer on screen
nearest: two points as near: the first in the data's order
nearest: two points at one x: the one nearer in height
nearest: a point past the zoomed value axis is no candidate, though drawn at the edge it would be nearest
nearest: none within the radius
nearest: none on screen
nearest: on a value axis of ±0.001 (G2), by the axis's exact scale
nearest: on a value axis of ±1e6
nearest: on a log x axis, by the distance on screen
nearest: on a level line the silent floor (-250 and below) is no point
nearest: on plain values -300 is a value
nearest: the last point, the pointer past it within the radius
under: none near, the point nearest along the axis
under: two points as near along the axis: the first in the data's order
under: two points at one x: the first in the data's order
under: a point past the zoomed value axis is read under the pointer, whatever its value
under: on a log x axis, nearest by ratio, not by difference
under: a point with no value is skipped for the nearest one with a value
under: a level line's silent floor is skipped
under: a plain line's -300 is read
under: NaN is no value
under: -Infinity on a plain line is no value
under: past the line's last point the pointer is over none of it
under: before the line's first point the pointer is over none of it
under: within half a pixel of the last point it is under the pointer
under: inside a gap longer than the pick window, no value at this place: answered empty, not pending (R7's gap rule)
under: a gap shorter than the pick window is passed over: the nearest point with a value in it
step+: the next point
step-: the point before
step+: from the first of two points at one x, the second
step-: from the second of two points at one x, the first
step+: from the second of two points at one x, the next x
step-: from the first of two points at one x, the x before
step+: across points with no value
step-: across points with no value
step+: a gap longer than the pick window is crossed in one step, never onto a point with no value
step-: a gap longer than the pick window is crossed in one step, never onto a point with no value
step+: a level line crosses its silent floor
step+: a plain line steps onto -300
step+: onto a value past the zoomed value axis
step+: Infinity and NaN are no values
step-: Infinity and NaN are no values
step+: past the plot's side there is nothing to read
step+: from the last point, none
step-: from the first point, none
step+: on a log x axis
click: on the second of two points of one height 4 px apart, the second, as the readout reads it (never the first within a hit radius of the click's own)
click: half way between two points of one height, as near to each: the first in the data's order, as the readout reads it
click: two points at one x (dots drawn over each other): the one nearer in height, as the readout reads it
click: in the gap between two points, none within the radius: the point under the pointer, as the readout reads it
click: inside a gap of the line with no value, the readout says "no value at this place": the click acts on nothing
click: past the line's last point the readout reads none: the click acts on nothing
